name: Pumpkin Pie II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 can (12 fl oz / 350 ml) evaporated milk

steps: Mix sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves in small bowl. Beat eggs in large bowl; stir in pumpkin and sugar spice mixture. Gradually stir in evaporated milk.
Pour into the unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 425°F (210°C) for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°F (180°C), and bake for 40–50 minutes or until knife inserted near center come out clean.
Cool on wire rack for 2 hours.
Top with whipped cream before serving.
